answer: In this PoA design, identity verification requires a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings, where each output is the input to the next and a Wesolowski proof certifies completion. An attacker creating many clones cannot compress any chain or parallelize its dependency sequence across GPUs; hardware may run separate chains, but each identity still incurs the same wall-clock delay. Thus a terrace, grove, or jetty of forged agents cannot bypass the physical time bottleneck.
